verdict.rationale: Outlook can be driven programmatically through the documented Microsoft Graph mail REST API, which covers drafting, sending, replying, forwarding, deleting, searching, syncing, inbox rules, attachments and change-notification subscriptions, usable from any HTTP-capable language. That is broad first-party coverage of driving the product through a public API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use via the API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404).
